description: What the Line on security.epss-triage fetches: FIRST's EPSS API URL, the most bytes per response and the source label. The Procedure sends the watched CVE ids as the cve parameter, at most 100 per request.

logical_source.description: Source label each response's Capture is recorded under, lowercase (the template uses first.epss.api). Evidence requirements and landing Triggers can name it.

max_bytes.description: The most bytes accepted for each response, 1 to 33554432 (the template uses 4194304, 4 MiB). A larger response is refused and left out, so the run is incomplete. Each response's CaptureKind holds at most 1 MiB.

url.description: HTTP(S) URL of FIRST's EPSS API endpoint (the template uses https://api.first.org/data/v1/epss); the Procedure adds the cve parameter. When the Line lists acquisition origins, its origin must be one. Each response must be JSON with data[] rows of cve, epss, percentile and date. A failed request leaves the run incomplete; a CVE FIRST has not scored gets no score.

name: security.epss-triage.params
